Step:  
03-16-1487 minus 347 days.  
347 days = 365 - 18 = subtract 1 year (1486) and add 18 days back.  
1487 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but 1487 < 1582, so Julian calendar applies; 1487 mod 4 = 3, so not leap).  
So 03-16-1487 minus 1 year = 03-16-1486.  
Add 18 days to 03-16-1486: March has 31 days, so 03-16 + 18 days = 04-03-1486.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1486-04-03
